mira: quick alert  ran onboarding smoke for orpheus-13b-int3 on long-window prompts (24k window) and saw consistent tail drift after an eviction boundary. repro ~4/10. anyone seen an eviction->rope-wrap artifact before? :eyes:

dan: can you paste the exact bench command and the eviction config? was this on private or dedicated?

mira: private cluster vpc-evc-2. command: `./run_longctx --model orpheus-13b-int3 --ctx 24576 --steps 4000 --seed 7 --mode streaming` env: `KV_EVICTION_THRESHOLD=0.75 KV_PREFETCH=1 KV_WRITE_PARALLELISM=2`

mira: failing log snippet:
```
[2026-03-05T14:22:11Z] kvcache: eviction triggered shard=1 at global_pos=16384 keep=1200
[2026-03-05T14:22:11Z] kvcache: prefetch start token=16384 len=64
[2026-03-05T14:22:11Z] attention: rope-scale=auto
[2026-03-05T14:22:11Z] model: quant=int3
[2026-03-05T14:22:12Z] WARN: kv-read length mismatch expected=64 got=56
[2026-03-05T14:22:12Z] ERROR: rope phase discontinuity at pos=16384 prev_phase=0x9a curr_phase=0x1f
```

tess: interesting. WARN length mismatch suggests partial write/eviction race. int3 packing is funky; few-byte writes could be truncated by eviction policy. can you reproduce with `KV_PREFETCH=0`?

mira: tried that: PV=0 drops repro to 1/10 from 4/10. setting `KV_WRITE_PARALLELISM=1` drops to 0/10. so parallel writes + prefetch + eviction seems like a plausible triad.

dan: can you run one failing case with `REDWOOD_DUMP_KV_ON_ERROR=1` and `REDWOOD_KV_LOCK=0/1` toggled? I'd like to diff the on-disk kv blocks.

mira: uploaded two dumps: `/tmp/kv.1826004321.bad.bin` and `/tmp/kv.1826004321.good.bin` (good run was single-threaded writes). using `tools/kv_diff.py /tmp/kv.*` shows an 8-byte shift around offset 0x3f40.

kai: 8-byte shift aligns with our block header size. could the int3 packer be failing to update meta-length atomically? we had a change last quarter to allow in-place pack for perf.

tess: add `ROPE_VERBOSE=1` to capture pos->phase mapping. also run with `KV_META_ATOMIC=1` if available to see if it mitigates.

mira: ran `KV_META_ATOMIC=1` + `KV_PREFETCH=1` + parallelism=2 -> 0/10 failures. so meta atomic update appears to mitigate. leaving a note that this is likely ordering (meta write vs data write).

dan: from eval POV, does this corruption change downstream generation quality significantly? did you diff against a golden output?

mira: yes  compared the streaming output vs golden single-threaded run. diffs are small token substitutions localized to ~300 tokens after eviction boundary. coherence persists but a few hallucinated nouns. for our LLMQA long-run eval the QA score drops 6 points on failing examples. so nontrivial.

kai: file INF-4011 with dumps, diffs, and the minimal repro script. tag eng-ml and eng-runtime. I can start a bisect between the in-place pack change and the KV writer rev that landed in 2026-01.

ci-bot: nightly bench 2026-03-06-03:00 completed for branch feature/orpheus-onboard  8/120 tests failed (detailed logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/2026-03-06/2026-03-06-0300)

dan: also try `--rope-scale none` to see if RoPE scaling math itself is sensitive; if turning it off removes errors it points at the phase buffer being touched at the wrong time.

mira: `--rope-scale none` reduced repro 4/10 -> 2/10. so it interacts but doesn't fully explain it.

tess: schedule a short pairing session tomorrow with kai and me; we'll run ASAN build and enable `KV_WRITE_SERIALIZE=1` instrumentation. also add a microbench that alternates `evict->prefetch->write` tight loop to stress.

kai: agreed. I'll also instrument the pack path to emit `(addr, len, hdr)` before/after writes so we can see partial updates.

mira: adding reproducible tiny script to the ticket: `tests/repro/int3_eviction_repro.py --steps 800 --seed 7` that flips KV vars via env. dropping into INF-4011 now. pinging @kai @tess.

dan: thanks. for prioritization: high for private deploys and any RL users. tag product as FYI.

mira: thanks y'all. will post the microbench results and ASAN logs in INF-4011 tomorrow morning. :coffee:"
